title: Production findings from the nova pass fixed
result: records without a usable source IP are skipped and counted instead of failing the whole report (7250569); `ip_hostname_enrichments` timestamps default to unix seconds, with migration 0040 rebuilding the table and converting the text values (d2d0045); scheduler run lines carry a timestamp and each failed hostname lookup logs its IP and error (8d69c62); the standalone output no longer traces the project root (85deafa); expired sessions and poll events older than 90 days are pruned daily (4bda7a4).
evidence: `pnpm run check:ci` exit 0 on the integrated main, 144 test files and 767 tests passed, `check-migrations: OK`; each change reviewed separately.
